findings: Board/governance artifacts (minutes, resolutions, consents): OWNED by the entity back-office convergent (holdings-corporate-mgmt substrate / api.holdings row). No GovernanceArtifact Noun minted here.

Public filings (lobbying disclosures, proxy/IR corpora): OWNED by the public-record read-layer convergent. The Disclosure Noun here is bound `federated` — a corporate-affairs view, not a second system of record; unwired and synthetic at wave zero (source route [UNVERIFIED]).

Residual owned grain: the stakeholder relationship register + engagement log (Stakeholder, Engagement — native) and press-mention records (Mention — generated). The GAP is NOT fully benign: this residual slice is real and no other row serves it.

openQuestion: Row note carried verbatim: the function may decompose entirely into records other properties already own, which would make the GAP benign. The wave-zero decomposition check (above) found a residual stakeholder/engagement grain that no other row owns — a founder ruling on whether that residual justifies a standalone acquisition (#16) or folds into an adjacent property is still open.
